last.verdict: Pfizer raised 2026 guidance on strong new-product growth, but total sales were flat as COVID products shrank and Prevnar fell.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue guidance rose $1.5B at the midpoint to $62-64B. Adjusted EPS guidance is now $2.95-$3.05, up from $2.80-$3.00, even after a roughly $0.10 licensing charge.

takeaways.label: Non-COVID business growing
takeaways.text: Excluding COVID products, sales grew 7% operationally. Recently launched and acquired drugs grew 32%, led by Padcev (+55%) and Lorbrena (+43%). Total revenue was flat at $16.6B.

takeaways.label: Eliquis boost is partly pricing
takeaways.text: Eliquis rose 25% (+$513M), driven mainly by higher U.S. net price from lower rebates and channel mix. That lift may not recur as steady demand growth.

takeaways.label: COVID and Prevnar drag
takeaways.text: Paxlovid fell 63% and Comirnaty 29%. Prevnar dropped 10% on lower U.S. vaccination rates and lost adult market share, so a core vaccine franchise is weakening.

history.verdict: Earnings beat and a higher revenue outlook gave shares a modest lift.

reasons.label: Beat on profit
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $0.77 beat the roughly $0.68 analysts expected; revenue was $15.0B.

reasons.label: Revenue outlook raised
reasons.text: Full-year revenue guidance rose $500M at the midpoint, to $60.5-$62.5B.

reasons.label: COVID sales shrinking
reasons.text: COVID product sales forecast cut to about $4B from $5B, capping enthusiasm.
